comparisons.peer_topic: Software strategy and open source contributions
comparisons.peer_summary: Intel aims to optimize AI frameworks and maintains the OpenVINO toolkit for deep learning inference. In 2024, Intel launched the Open Platform for Enterprise AI under the Linux Foundation and contributed oneAPI specifications to the UXL Foundation to enable open, multi-vendor programming across accelerators.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and INTC describe software strategies aimed at optimizing performance and enabling efficient execution of workloads, though they target different layers of the stack. AVGO's VeloCloud utilizes its VeloRAIN architecture to optimize connectivity and quality of service across fixed or mobile environments, focusing on network-level performance and security. In contrast, Intel focuses on optimizing AI frameworks and middleware (such as PyTorch and TensorFlow) to run efficiently on its hardware, leveraging its oneAPI and OpenVINO toolkit for cross-architecture application development. While AVGO's software defines the networking behavior and outcome-based service, Intel's software strategy is centered on accelerating inference and unifying programming across different processor types.

sentences.text: By combining our VeloRAIN (Robust AI Networking) architecture with seamless connectivity and outcome-based quality of service, VeloCloud provides users and devices with compute and connectivity to optimize performance, security and reliability across fixed or mobile environments, while simplifying operations.
We aim to optimize AI frameworks and middleware, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, vLLM, Hugging Face and WebNN to run efficiently on our hardware.

Our OpenVINO™ toolkit is an open source toolkit that accelerates deep learning inference on our processors across various use cases, such as generative AI, computer vision, audio, and language with industry standard models.

comparisons.peer_topic: NVIDIA RTX Technology and AI Integration
comparisons.peer_summary: NVIDIA RTX enhances gaming through real-time ray tracing for cinematic-quality rendering and DLSS, an AI technology that boosts frame rates, positioning RTX as the AI PC leader with over 100 million AI-capable PCs and 500+ enabled applications.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and NVDA highlight the integration of AI technologies to enhance user experience and performance in consumer or client-facing devices, but they address different segments. AVGO's VeloCloud combines AI networking (VeloRAIN) to optimize connectivity and reliability for users and devices in fixed or mobile environments. NVDA positions its RTX technology as the leader in AI PCs, using AI-driven Deep Learning Super Sampling (DLSS) to boost frame rates and improve graphics rendering for gaming. Both companies emphasize 'AI' as a key driver for performance optimization, with AVGO focusing on network connectivity reliability and NVDA focusing on graphical rendering efficiency.

sentences.text: By combining our VeloRAIN (Robust AI Networking) architecture with seamless connectivity and outcome-based quality of service, VeloCloud provides users and devices with compute and connectivity to optimize performance, security and reliability across fixed or mobile environments, while simplifying operations.
NVIDIA RTX also features deep learning super sampling, or NVIDIA DLSS, our AI technology that boosts frame rates while generating beautiful, sharp images for games.
With an installed base of over 100 million AI capable PCs, more than 500 RTX AI-enabled applications and games, and a robust suite of development tools, RTX is already the AI PC leader.

comparisons.peer_topic: Processor architecture and AI Engine capabilities
comparisons.peer_summary: Qualcomm utilizes System-on-Chip architecture with heterogeneous computing, including Oryon and Kryo CPUs and Adreno GPUs, to enable high-performance, low-power computing. The Qualcomm AI Engine features dedicated hardware and the Hexagon NPU for high-performance on-device AI inference, supported by the AI Stack and AI Hub to simplify developer integration.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and QCOM describe proprietary architectures that integrate specialized processing engines to optimize performance for specific user outcomes. AVGO's VeloCloud uses the VeloRAIN (Robust AI Networking) architecture to optimize performance, security, and reliability across mobile or fixed environments. Similarly, Qualcomm describes its System-on-Chip (SoC) architecture with heterogeneous computing (CPU, GPU, NPU) and the Qualcomm AI Engine with its Hexagon NPU to enable high-performance, low-power computing and on-device AI inference. Both disclosures underscore the use of dedicated hardware or architectural logic (AI networking vs. AI Engine/NPU) to deliver optimized experiences for end-user devices.

sentences.text: By combining our VeloRAIN (Robust AI Networking) architecture with seamless connectivity and outcome-based quality of service, VeloCloud provides users and devices with compute and connectivity to optimize performance, security and reliability across fixed or mobile environments, while simplifying operations.

We have developed System-on-Chip (SoC) architecture with heterogeneous computing features, which uses our central processing unit (CPU) and different types of specialized engines (graphics processing unit (GPU) and neural processing unit (NPU)) to enable high-performance and low-power computing and other optimization techniques.

The Qualcomm® AI Engine, featured in our Snapdragon platforms and many of our other products, includes dedicated hardware capable of running complex AI use cases at high-performance and low-power on device, while also enhancing privacy and security.
